parts.name: tube body

physics.Basic_description: Red matte plastic cylindrical tube forming the main body of the lipstick container.
physics.Functional_description: Houses the internal mechanism and provides the primary structure for the base.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the cylindrical side surface with a parallel jaw gripper to stabilize the object.
physics.reason: Injection molded plastic shell enclosing empty space for the mechanism.

parts.description: Red matte plastic cylindrical tube forming the main body of the lipstick container.
parts.function: Houses the internal mechanism and provides the primary structure for the base.

parts.name: center band

physics.Basic_description: Green ring band located at the junction between the cap and the tube body.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as a decorative collar or structural reinforcement at the opening.
physics.Grasped_description: Too narrow and flush to be a primary grasp target; avoid grasping here.
physics.reason: Thin ring structure surrounding the tube opening.

parts.description: Green ring band located at the junction between the cap and the tube body.
parts.function: Acts as a decorative collar or structural reinforcement at the opening.

parts.name: hinge lug

physics.Basic_description: Small blue plastic protrusion at the base rim serving as a hinge mount.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the pivot point for the hinged cap mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and fragile to grasp; avoid contact to prevent breakage.
physics.reason: Small structural feature likely solid or thick-walled to support hinge pin.

parts.description: Small blue plastic protrusion at the base rim serving as a hinge mount.
parts.function: Provides the pivot point for the hinged cap mechanism.

parts.name: slider body

physics.Basic_description: Yellow rectangular slider button visible on the side of the tube.
physics.Functional_description: Mechanism to extend or retract the lipstick bullet.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be pressed or slid by a finger or gripper tip, but not suitable for lifting the object.
physics.reason: Small functional component, likely solid plastic block.

parts.description: Yellow rectangular slider button visible on the side of the tube.
parts.function: Mechanism to extend or retract the lipstick bullet.

parts.name: bullet red

physics.Basic_description: Orange-red waxy cylinder representing the lipstick product inside the tube.
physics.Functional_description: The consumable cosmetic material applied to lips.
physics.Grasped_description: Soft and deformable; grasping would damage the product.

parts.description: Orange-red waxy cylinder representing the lipstick product inside the tube.
parts.function: The consumable cosmetic material applied to lips.

parts.name: cap shell

physics.Basic_description: Purple matte plastic conical shell forming the lid of the container.
physics.Functional_description: Covers and protects the lipstick bullet when closed.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the outer surface to open or close the lid; primary manipulation point.
physics.reason: Thin-walled injection molded cover enclosing air.

parts.description: Purple matte plastic conical shell forming the lid of the container.
parts.function: Covers and protects the lipstick bullet when closed.

parts.name: hinge knuckle

physics.Basic_description: Cyan plastic component at the cap base forming the other half of the hinge.
physics.Functional_description: Connects the cap to the base allowing rotational movement.
physics.Grasped_description: Structural joint; avoid grasping to prevent stress on the hinge.
physics.reason: Thickened structural area around the hinge pin.

parts.description: Cyan plastic component at the cap base forming the other half of the hinge.
parts.function: Connects the cap to the base allowing rotational movement.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained

simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)
